intent: Three costume/identity review revisions; separate from existing Unity scene assets.

prompts.Warrior:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: Warrior full-body costume revision.
Image 1 is the edit target: existing fully enclosed armored male Warrior. Image 2 is a supporting reference ONLY for the strong white fabric mass around the upper torso, not its character identity, hood, sword or pose.
Keep the current Warrior's helmet and completely covered face, body proportions, practical iron armor, sword, wooden shield, pose, gloves, belt and boots. Restore cloth primarily ON THE UPPER BODY: a simple chalk-white short shoulder mantle wrapped asymmetrically across the collarbones and upper chest, fastened by one plain iron clasp, ending around the lower ribs. Leave some iron breastplate and a shoulder plate visible. Bold clean white silhouette, just a few broad folds and flat pale-grey shadows. No hood; keep the distinctive iron helmet exposed. The WHITE upper mantle is his main color accent instead of yellow/ochre. Change the yellow arming jacket to subdued charcoal grey so it supports the white mantle. Keep the lower half compact and practical: dark trousers and existing knee/shin plates, no trailing cloth strips, long tabard, long cape, sash or decorative skirt. The white cloth is cared for but inexpensive; beginning adventurer, not a lavish paladin. No gold trim, ornament, crest or holy symbol. Preserve the approved style and original identity; only revise these costume color/fabric elements.
Preserve the project's approved angular dark-fantasy cartoon art: heavy near-black expressive outlines, clean sharp silhouettes, broad flat cel-shadow shapes, compact adult proportions about six heads tall, expressive hands and substantial feet. Economical confident detail, muted limited earthy colors. No gradient, glow, halo, microtexture, grain, dithering, polished realistic rendering, glossy anime look, or lower-resolution pixelation. Full-body original character cutout, generous margins, all equipment and feet visible, transparent background. No scenery, ground shadow, text, lettering, signature, watermark, comparison sheet, or extra characters. Native tall portrait artwork.
prompts.Samurai:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: redesigned female Samurai full-body game character.
Image 1 is the main visual reference for the requested adult female fighter attitude, wrapped chest and angular illustration language. Image 2 is the prior male Samurai: retain his restrained Eastern swordsman atmosphere, long dark hair, simple katana and overall project's visual style, while deliberately replacing him with an original adult woman.
Design a clearly adult woman around age 30, mature angular face and confident stern composure, athletic trained build, long black hair loosely tied into a high ponytail with a few broad strands framing the face. Both eyes visible. Do not copy the reference's exact face, scars, pose, giant cleaver or existing-character identity.
Opaque broad ivory sarashi bandages securely wrapped across the entire bust, bare midriff and one bare shoulder. A muted dark rust-red outer kimono jacket is worn asymmetrically: ONLY ONE arm is inside its sleeve, the opposite side has slipped down off the bare shoulder and is secured at the waist. Make this one-sleeve / one-bare-arm construction unmistakable, with broad simple cloth shapes. Retain a noticeable practical dark iron two-piece shoulder guard ON THE CLOTHED SHOULDER; it should define the silhouette without ornate details. Simple dark charcoal hakama trousers with broad folds, waist sash with short ends only, practical wraps and sandals. A normal-sized subtly curved Japanese katana held in the bare sword arm, angled down and outward, other hand near a plain dark scabbard at the hip. The image must read instantly as a Samurai, not a Barbarian, cleaver wielder or armored knight. Full standing three-quarter view, composed balanced swordfighter stance. Clearly adult proportions and mature bearing; avoid childlike face, chibi proportions, glamour pin-up posing, extra jewelry, many scars, loose belts or busy costume detail. The chest wrapping remains securely opaque.

prompts.Wizard:

He must look dignified, studious and materially comfortable, without looking like a king or final-boss archmage. Clean structured ankle-length robe in muted deep slate-indigo, broad flat dark shadow planes, straight intact hems, neat cream standing collar and cream turned cuffs, a narrow restrained ochre edging only at collar and cuffs. A simple plain leather belt, a SINGLE closed compact book held at his side, sensible well-kept dark leather boots. Preserve a simple pointed wizard hat, now clean tailored slate-indigo fabric, no frayed points, rips, patches or dirt. Replace the rough wrapped branch staff with a straight polished dark wooden scholar's staff, a modest faceted geometric wooden head with a small iron cap; no glowing jewel, no ornate filigree, no giant crystal. Upright composed posture, alert mildly curious eyes while retaining his serious elderly expression.
